snippet.description:
Learn Chord of Curvature formulas, length of chord parallel to coordinate axes, passing through pole, and pedal equations with solved examples for BSc Maths.

Is video lecture me hum Differential Calculus ka important topic Chord of Curvature (वक्रता जीवा) detail me study karenge. Hum derivation dekhne wale hain:

Length of Chord Parallel to X-Axis & Y-Axis 
Length of Chord Passing Through Pole 
Length of Chord Perpendicular to Radius Vector 
Length of Chord for Pedal Equations

Saath hi university exams ke liye important examples aur previous year questions ko step-by-step solve kiya gaya hai taaki aapka concept pura clear ho sake.

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Circle and Centre of Curvature
01:30 - Concept & Definition of Chord of Curvature
05:40 - Length of Chord of Curvature Parallel to Axes (Derivation)
14:04 - Length of Chord of Curvature Passing Through Pole (Derivation)
17:18 - Chord of Curvature Perpendicular to Radius Vector (Derivation)
19:20 - Summary of Chord of Curvature Formulas
21:42 - Example 1: Proving Chord Parallel to Y-Axis is Constant
26:35 - Example 2: Relation Between Chords Parallel to Axes for Catenary
35:22 - Example 3: Chord Passing Through Pole for Cardioid 
44:03 - Example 4: Chord Passing Through Pole for Pedal Equation
46:36 - Lecture Summary & Introduction to Partial Differentiation

Agar aap BSc Mathematics, Engineering Maths ya competitive exams ki preparation kar rahe hain, to ye lecture aapke liye bahut helpful hoga. Video ko like karein, share karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Centre of Curvature → https://youtu.be/TkXsflv0PmU

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd
